notes: Ganymede 0.8.3 (beta): the rune fixes from the 10-13 Balance review.
Media with nothing playing says so in words only: no empty album square, no empty progress line.
Power plan shows the plan’s whole name a size smaller (“PERFORMANCE”), never “PERFORMA…”, and cuts it only below the smallest readable size.
Laptop, Charm look, on a wide strip: no stray “—” ahead of CHARGE on a PC that reports no model (also on Mirage).
Volume, Microphone and Brightness on a thin strip: a Default that sat small in the middle (Microphone at 592×90) gives way to the Line look, which fills the card.
